name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Blue Razz
description:
Sweet, tart, and seriously satisfying. The Mad Labs Blue Razz disposable delivers bold blue raspberry flavor in a full 2-gram, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no hassle. Just pick it up and pull.

Blue Razz is all about that nostalgic candy-shop punch: juicy blue raspberry up front, a bright tangy snap in the middle, and a smooth sweet finish that keeps you coming back. It's a flavor-forward crowd-pleaser built for anyone who likes their sessions fun, easy, and full of taste.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Bold Blue Razz flavor — tart blue raspberry with a sweet candy finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last

Big flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Blue Razz is ready whenever you are.
